title: Add ability-first guided character creation flow
description:
Implement the guided CLI flow for the nostalgia/discovery path: Ability-first — let the dice inspire me.

Step order
identity/loose concept → ability score method → roll/enter/assign scores → class recommendations → class → ancestry → background → remaining choices → spells/equipment → review

Design intent
Ability-first should support the Eshyra user profile that enjoys 80s-era RPG discovery: see what the scores suggest, then choose a class and ancestry that fit. It should not be hostile or random-only; users may enter or assign scores depending on supported methods.

Acceptance criteria
- User can choose the exact ability-first mode label.
- Ability scores can be collected before class.
- The flow offers deterministic class-fit suggestions from score data and recipe metadata.
- The user can still choose a poor fit if desired after a warning or neutral explanation.
- Later class/ancestry selection reuses the same resolver and validation engine as concept-first.
- Transcript-style tests cover a representative ability-first path.
notes: PR #304 open for review: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/304. Ability-first mode in the shared wizard: new ability-method step, deterministic class-recommendations panel (recommendClasses, advisory; poor-fit allowed), and a roll command (rollAbilityScoreSet) with an injected seeded RNG. CLI-only, reuses core. Tests: ability-first transcript, seeded roll, poor-fit override. verify:worktree green (2516 passed/19 skipped). Unblocks b69j.15.
